name: Theologia Crucis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The revelation of God in the suffering of the cross

VINIT.justification: The hidden God prior to any self-disclosure or creative act.

TANCH.justification: The final closure where all suffering and revelation terminate in the glory of God.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement of the divine toward the human condition.

AREV.justification: The self-emptying descent into lowliness and negation.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of divine and human attributes in one person.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition of God in the specific suffering man.

FSPLIT.justification: The event that branches into the perception of the world and the perception of faith.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the crucified life into the eternal life of God.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative recognition of God in suffering.

EVALF.justification: The false pursuit of God through power and works.

ENGAGR.justification: The state of being simultaneously justified and a sinner.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible record of the revelation.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the hidden God before the Word is spoken.
phase_3.true_description: The recognition of divine presence in the midst of suffering.
phase_3.false_description: The rejection of the cross in favor of human wisdom and strength.
phase_3.both_description: The tension of faith where God is found in his opposite.

steps.domain_action: The hidden God exists in absolute transcendence.
God initiates the movement toward humanity through the Word.
The Word assumes human nature in the person of Christ.
God identifies himself with the human condition.
The life of Christ reaches the crisis of the cross.
The F-arm descends into the experience of godforsakenness and death.
The theology of glory fails to find God in the suffering.
The T-arm carries the promise of grace through the sacrifice.
The theology of the cross affirms God is present in this negation.
The believer holds the reality of death and the promise of life together.
The resurrection reunites the crucified one with the divine life.
The event is fixed in the apostolic witness and the sacraments.
The system closes in the final justification of the believer.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who interprets the cross to the believer.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The proclamation of the Word and the administration of sacraments.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The tradition of the church and the collective memory of the faithful.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The liturgical year and the timing of divine providence.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Bible as the primary source of the revelation.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The death of the old self and the surrender of human reason.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The human attempt to reach God through works and glory.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The human reception of God through faith and suffering.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The loss of the self is balanced by the gain of Christ.
